From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Post-demo: ACME Health IAM questions + evidence request

Hi Sofia / Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the IAM/security side we discussed:

1) SOC 2 status: we confirmed Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II in place (most recent report covers Oct 2024–Sep 2025). I attached a one-page summary (we can provide the full report under NDA).

2) SSO/SAML: ACME asked for SAML metadata and SSO configuration guidance. We can supply our SAML metadata file and step-by-step setup notes for Okta/Azure AD.

3) SCIM provisioning: we support SCIM v2 for just-in-time user provisioning and deprovisioning. I included a sample request/response and our rate limits.

4) RBAC and admin controls: outline of built-in roles (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Team Lead, Viewer) plus how to create custom roles via the Console API.

5) Audit logs: retention windows and excerpt format (we retain admin/audit logs for 13 months by default; longer retention is available as an add-on).

Next steps I suggest:
- Sofia: confirm the primary IAM contact(s) who will own the questionnaire and whether ACME needs the full SOC 2 under NDA.
- Jordan: share the vendor security questionnaire (if you prefer, procurement can upload to the Drive link).
- Redwood: Neha and Marissa will prepare the SAML metadata, SCIM sample, and a short RBAC admin-controls doc by EOD tomorrow.

I attached the SOC2 summary and the SAML metadata to get started.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — great demo. A few quick items from our side:

1) Procurement attached the vendor questionnaire (see attached XLSX). We need standard items plus a short section on PHI handling (HIPAA).
2) For SOC 2: we will want the full report under NDA. Can you confirm the last control testing period and who on your team handles the NDA/secure transfer?
3) SAML: Okta is our IdP. Please confirm if you support IdP-initiated flows and whether we need to supply a certificate or you will provide SP metadata.
4) SCIM: we prefer SCIM provisioning. Can you share any examples for group mappings and attribute sync (email, jobTitle, department)? Also, what is your typical provisioning throughput?

Jordan — looped you for procurement next steps. Procurement will review the questionnaire this morning and flag any missing fields.

Subject: Fwd: ACME questionnaire + SAML/SCIM asks (need evidence pack)

Team — forwarding ACME's questionnaire and their IAM questions. They specifically want:
- Full SOC 2 Type II report (under NDA) and confirmation of the testing window
- SAML SP metadata and a short doc detailing IdP-initiated vs SP-initiated support and cert handling
- SCIM v2 examples: group sync mapping, sample provisioning payloads, API rate limits, and attribute filtering notes
- RBAC & admin controls: list of built-in roles, how to request custom roles, examples of admin audit entries
- PHI/HIPAA notes: how we segregate data, encryption at-rest and in-transit, and any BAAs/DPAs we already have in place

Can Neha and Marissa assemble the initial pack (SOC2 summary + SAML metadata + SCIM sample + RBAC admin doc) and I will coordinate NDA for the full report. Karthik — please confirm whether we have a pre-approved NDA workflow for SOC2 transfer or if we need Legal to run a new one.

Please reply with ETA; ACME expects a turnaround this week if possible.

—
Dylan
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: ACME Health IAM questions + evidence request

Hi Sofia / Jordan —

Thanks, and glad to move quickly. Quick answers and what's attached:

- SOC 2: confirming the testing period was 2024-10-01 to 2025-09-30. We have uploaded the SOC 2 Type II report to a secure ShareFile link; we require a standard NDA before release. I can start the NDA process today — please confirm the signatory and email for legal routing.

- SAML: we support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. Attached is our redwood-saml-metadata.xml and a one-page setup guide for Okta and Azure AD. You will need to upload our SP metadata to your IdP; certificate rotation is handled by us and communicated 30 days in advance.

- SCIM: attached is redwood-scim-api-sample.json showing common attributes (userName/email/givenName/familyName/jobTitle/department). We support group mappings via an attribute called memberOf; provisioning throughput is typically 50 requests/sec for enterprise pods — we can raise that for dedicated deployments.

- RBAC/Admin: attached is a short RBAC-doc that lists roles and admin UI screenshots. Audit events include admin-user.create, admin-role.assign, api.token.created with timestamps and actor metadata.

- PHI/HIPAA: summary attached outlining encryption in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256), KMS integration options, and DPA/BAA status — we have a standard DPA and will engage Legal for a BAA template if ACME confirms it needs to move forward.

Attachments included: redwood-saml-metadata.xml, redwood-scim-api-sample.json, RINF_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf, RBAC_admin_controls.pdf

Happy to jump on a short call with your IAM/Procurement teams to walk through the questionnaire. Proposed: Mon 23 Feb at 10am ET?

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
